Hero_Desc_xXionx:
The black light of Elias who calls herself the 'Magic Bullet Slinger'.
She's a phantom who is deeply lost in her own world.
She may seem difficult at first glance, but it seems easy to befriend her if you cater to her liking for dark and serious things.
Album_Like_xXionx: Black items. Dark places. Advanced civilizations.
Album_xXionx1: An Eternal Life giving off an aura that's difficult to approach. She calls me, the Master, her rival, constantly keeping me in check, not to mention her habit of chuckling and muttering to herself at the most random times... The thought of getting close to this one feels like it would be pure agony.
Album_xXionx2: I've managed to strike up a casual conversation with Xion, and as expected, there were no surprises. Xion has an incredibly unique personality, and just listening to her talk feels like a nonstop cringe-fest, 24/7. I even asked if using that kind of speech wasn't exhausting, but she seemed too far gone—completely 'darkened'—to even understand the question.
Album_xXionx3: Regardless of her personality, Xion's shooting skills are undeniably remarkable. She showed me she could hit a bean at a distance of 100 footsteps, it was pretty surprising. However, after that, her overly dramatic, cringy speech intensified significantly... Could it be she was just as shocked as me by her accidental success?
Album_xXionx4: In Elias, where the concept of death has been greatly diluted, it's rare to come across its remnants. Curious about the skull Xion wears on her head, I asked where she had gotten it. She mumbled something difficult to comprehend. "When I left my mark on the Light and Dark Divide, I retrieved it from within the shadows as a trophy." The Light and Dark Divide... I guess that's the name of a gothic fashion shop run by elves in Monatium.
Album_xXionx5: Xion doesn't actually have heterochromia; she's just wearing colored contact lenses. She claims to have obtained these "Demonic Relics" long ago and that when she wears them, she can see the invisible lines of truth that others cannot. Xion then launched into an unintelligible monologue, but listening to it was so exhausting that I had to calm myself down by thinking about something else.
Album_xXionx6: Apparently, Xion is quite fond of smart devices made by elves, which is why she lives near Monatium. She proudly told me that she even owns a desktop PC. But once she got going, I had to endure an entire rant about why laptops and mobile devices were inferior. Xion also mentioned that she runs a website on the elves' intranet. The website is called... "Darknet." And her username? "Dark Bullet." I could've asked more, but I started feeling secondhand embarrassment and changed the subject.
Album_xXionx7: One early morning, I ran into Xion again at a convenience store in Monatium, and the encounter was... incredibly awkward. Gone was her usual edgy, dramatic way of speaking. Instead, all I saw was an ordinary part-timer standing behind the counter. Trying to break the silence, I asked when she had started working there. Lowering her face in embarrassment, Xion muttered under her breath, "Even the Magic Bullet Slinger cannot escape the reality of monthly rent in Monatium..."

LoveCall_xXionx:
Master... No, my Master.
A considerable time has passed since you and I began walking together.
As those shared days accumulated, your mental world and mine overlapped like an eclipse and entered resonance.
With our hearts in resonance, it is only natural that my thoughts turn to you.

Light and shadow are ever inseparable.
Because you exist as brilliant light, I may remain beside you like a shadow.
You have now become one whose fate is joined with mine.
I am you, and you are me. Though all else may change, this heart shall remain eternal.
Bearing these feelings, I declare once more:

Whenever you require my aid, contact me!
I look forward to our continued bond! Thank you, Master!
Dark Bullet
